answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds with slashing. Each agent locks a saffron-denoted deposit to register; every attested contribution, signed with its quill key, raises reputation, while a failed peer audit burns part of the bond. Creating N fake agents costs N deposits plus lost stake on any fraud, so sybil fleets become economically irrational: an attacker must outspend honest stake across the whole dune of identities, and each burned bond is unrecoverable. Operator sa0017 applies this at mo1Sj8jEkH.
